skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Write a compact, source-linked handoff note so another session, agent, or machine can resume the work without re-reading the whole conversation. Use when the user says handoff, 交接, 换会话, 继续做, resume later, or when a long session is ending.

skills.name: shell-review
skills.description: Review shell scripts for destructive commands, quoting and portability bugs, and offline-install safety before running or shipping them. Use when the user asks to review, harden, or debug a .sh script, an installer, a Makefile shell block, or a command containing rm -rf, curl | sh, sudo, or eval.
